helmfile/helmfile.yaml:
repositories:
  - name: temporal
    url: https://temporalio.github.io/helm-charts
  - name: bitnami
    url: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
  - name: elastic
    url: https://helm.elastic.co

environments:
  dev:
    values:
      - values-development.yaml
  prod:
    values:
      - values-production.yaml
  eks:
    values:
      - values-eks.yaml

releases:
  # PostgreSQL for Temporal
  - name: temporal-postgresql
    namespace: temporal
    chart: bitnami/postgresql
    version: 16.7.27
    values:
      - global:
          postgresql:
            auth:
              postgresPassword: "temporal-postgres-password"
              database: "temporal"
        auth:
          username: "temporal"
          password: "temporal-password"
          database: "temporal"
        primary:
          persistence:
            enabled: true
            size: 500Gi
            storageClass: "ebs-volume-gp3-encrypted"
          # Increase memory limits to prevent OOM kills
          # Current: 192Mi limit (too low, causing OOM kills)
          # Recommended: 512Mi-1Gi for production workloads
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
        metrics:
          enabled: true
        commonAnnotations:
          argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "1"
        commonLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: temporal
          app.kubernetes.io/part-of: temporal

  # Redis for Temporal
  - name: temporal-redis
    namespace: temporal
    chart: bitnami/redis
    version: 17.17.1
    values:
      - auth:
          enabled: true
          password: "temporal-redis-password"
        master:
          persistence:
            enabled: true
            size: 500Gi
            storageClass: "ebs-volume-gp3-encrypted"
        replica:
          replicaCount: 1
          persistence:
            enabled: true
            size: 500Gi
            storageClass: "ebs-volume-gp3-encrypted"
        metrics:
          enabled: true
        commonAnnotations:
          argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "1"
        commonLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: temporal
          app.kubernetes.io/part-of: temporal

  # Temporal Server with Web UI
  - name: temporal
    namespace: temporal
    chart: temporal/temporal
    version: 0.65.0
    # HF-08: declare explicit dependency order. Without these, helmfile sync deploys
    # all releases concurrently, racing temporal startup against its required Redis +
    # Postgres backends. First-deploy probability of frontend CrashLoopBackOff is high.
    needs:
      - temporal/temporal-postgresql
      - temporal/temporal-redis
    values:
      # Create default namespace automatically
      - namespaces:
          create: true
          namespace:
            - name: default
              retention: 72h
      - server:
          replicaCount: 1
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 2Gi
          # Environment variables for improved visibility indexing
          extraEnv:
            - name: TEMPORAL_VISIBILITY_STORE_MAX_QPS
              value: "1000"
            - name: TEMPORAL_ENABLE_VISIBILITY_SAMPLING
              value: "false"
            - name: TEMPORAL_SYSTEM_VISIBILITY_TASK_QUEUE_MAX_READ_LEVEL_IDLE_DURATION
              value: "10s"
            - name: TEMPORAL_SYSTEM_HISTORY_TASK_QUEUE_MAX_READ_LEVEL_IDLE_DURATION
              value: "10s"
          # Workflow execution history limits configuration
          # Increased from defaults (50,000 events, 50MB) to handle long-running scraper workflows
          config:
            limit:
              maxWorkflowExecutionHistorySize: "100MB"
              maxWorkflowExecutionHistoryCount: 100000
        matching:
          podAnnotations:
            prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
            prometheus.io/port: "9090"
            prometheus.io/job: "temporal-matching"
        history:
          podAnnotations:
            prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
            prometheus.io/port: "9090"
            prometheus.io/job: "temporal-history"
        frontend:
          podAnnotations:
            prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
            prometheus.io/port: "9090"
            prometheus.io/job: "temporal-frontend"
        worker:
          podAnnotations:
            prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
            prometheus.io/port: "9090"
            prometheus.io/job: "temporal-worker"
        web:
          enabled: true
          replicaCount: 1
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
          ingress:
            enabled: true
            className: alb
            annotations:
              kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/target-type: ip
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: HTTP
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/listen-ports: '[{"HTTP": 80}]'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-path: /
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-interval-seconds: '15'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-timeout-seconds: '5'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthy-threshold-count: '2'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/unhealthy-threshold-count: '2'
            hosts:
              - temporal-web.fqk5.kitt-inf.net
            paths:
              - /
            tls: []
        cassandra:
          enabled: true
          # Note: The Temporal Cassandra chart does NOT support metrics.enabled
          # Metrics are collected via cassandra-metrics-exporter StatefulSet (separate deployment)
          # Do NOT add prometheus.io annotations to Cassandra pods - they don't expose port 9500
          # The cassandra-metrics-exporter pods expose metrics on port 9500 and are scraped via ServiceMonitor
          # Enable JMX remote access for metrics exporter
          # JMX is required for cassandra-metrics-exporter to connect and collect metrics
          # Note: The Temporal Cassandra chart may not support all JVM options directly
          # A post-install hook will patch the StatefulSet with proper configuration
          config:
            # JVM options including gossip state fix
            # -Dcassandra.load_ring_state=false prevents loading stale gossip state on restart
            # This helps fix gossip issues when nodes have stale peer information
            jvm_opts: "-Dcassandra.consistent.rangemovement=false -Dcassandra.load_ring_state=false -Dcassandra.jmx.remote.port=7199 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=7199 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.rmi.port=7199 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -Djava.rmi.server.hostname=$(POD_IP)"
          # Seed nodes configuration for gossip protocol
          # All nodes should be seeds in a small cluster (3 nodes) for better discovery
          # This will be patched via a post-install hook job
          # Persistence configuration - note: chart may not support this directly
          # A post-install hook job will patch the StatefulSet to add persistent volumes
          persistence:
            enabled: true
            size: 100Gi
            storageClass: "ebs-volume-gp3-encrypted"
        persistence:
          defaultStore: default
          default:
            driver: "cassandra"
            cassandra:
              hosts:
                - "temporal-cassandra.temporal"
              port: 9042
              keyspace: "temporal"
              user: "user"
              password: "password"
              existingSecret: "temporal-default-store"
              replicationFactor: 3
              consistency:
                default:
                  consistency: "local_quorum"
                  serialConsistency: "local_serial"
          visibility:
            driver: "elasticsearch"
        elasticsearch:
          enabled: true
          replicas: 3
          host: elasticsearch-master-headless
          scheme: http
          port: 9200
          version: "v7"
          logLevel: "error"
          username: ""
          password: ""
          visibilityIndex: "temporal_visibility_v1_dev"
          # Override readiness probe to accept "yellow" cluster status instead of "green"
          # This prevents pods from being marked unready when cluster has unassigned replica shards
          # Yellow status means all primary shards are active (cluster is functional)
          # Green status requires all primary AND replica shards to be active (strict requirement)
          clusterHealthCheckParams: "wait_for_status=yellow&timeout=1s"
          # Enable X-Pack monitoring collection for Kibana Stack Monitoring
          # This enables Elasticsearch to collect and store monitoring metrics
          extraConfig:
            xpack.monitoring.collection.enabled: "true"
          # Increase Kibana memory limits to prevent OOM kills
          # Current: 512Mi limit (too low, causing OOM kills)
          # Recommended: 1Gi-2Gi for production workloads
          kibana:
            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 100m
                memory: 512Mi
              limits:
                cpu: 500m
                memory: 1Gi
          # Improved settings for child workflow visibility
          indices:
            temporal_visibility_v1_dev:
              settings:
                number_of_shards: 1
                number_of_replicas: 1
                refresh_interval: "1s"  # Faster refresh for better visibility
        redis:
          enabled: true
          host: temporal-redis-master
          port: 6379
          password: temporal-redis-password
        prometheus:
          enabled: true
          server:
            persistentVolume:
              enabled: true
              size: 500Gi  # Note: Cannot reduce size of existing PVC - would require deleting PVC first (data loss)
            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 500m
                memory: 8Gi
              limits:
                cpu: 2000m
                memory: 12Gi  # Increased from 4Gi to 8Gi to prevent OOMKilled restarts
            # Add ingress for Prometheus access
            ingress:
              enabled: true
              ingressClassName: alb
              annotations:
                kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/target-type: ip
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: HTTP
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/listen-ports: '[{"HTTP": 80}]'
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-path: /-/healthy
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-interval-seconds: '15'
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-timeout-seconds: '5'
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthy-threshold-count: '2'
                alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/unhealthy-threshold-count: '2'
              hosts:
                - temporal-prometheus.fqk5.kitt-inf.net
              paths:
                - /
              tls: []
            # Improve global scrape settings - match monitoring namespace best practices
            global:
              scrape_interval: 60s
              scrape_timeout: 30s
              evaluation_interval: 30s
          # Note: Namespace filtering is handled by patch-prometheus-config-job.yaml
          # which patches the existing kubernetes-service-endpoints and kubernetes-pods jobs
        grafana:
          enabled: true
          adminUser: "admin"
          adminPassword: "Yfd2HxAsXiQ7brwIoeR5i2tvYH2jmRSBViBsWRM8"
          # Enable persistence to prevent dashboard loss on pod restart
          persistence:
            enabled: true
            size: 10Gi
            storageClass: "ebs-volume-gp3-encrypted"
          # Dashboard provisioning via ConfigMaps
          # Dashboards are added to grafana-dashboards-default ConfigMap which is mounted by the init container
          # Custom dashboards: cassandra-grafana-dashboard.yaml, postgresql-grafana-dashboard.yaml, redis-grafana-dashboard.yaml
          # These are merged into grafana-dashboards-default ConfigMap via a post-install hook
          ingress:
            enabled: true
            ingressClassName: alb
            annotations:
              kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/target-type: ip
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: HTTP
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/listen-ports: '[{"HTTP": 80}]'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-path: /
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-interval-seconds: '15'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-timeout-seconds: '5'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthy-threshold-count: '2'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/unhealthy-threshold-count: '2'
            hosts:
              - temporal-grafana.fqk5.kitt-inf.net
            paths:
              - /
            tls: []
        commonAnnotations:
          argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "2"
        commonLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: temporal
          app.kubernetes.io/part-of: temporal
    hooks:
      # Clean up unwanted dashboards (remove Worker Service, Ping Latency, System Processes)
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - cleanup-unwanted-dashboards-job.yaml
      # Fix Kibana resources (increase memory limit to prevent OOM kills)
      # - events: ["postsync"]
      #   showlogs: true
      #   command: kubectl
      #   args:
      #     - apply
      #     - -f
      #     - fix-kibana-resources-job.yaml
      # Create default namespace after Temporal is deployed
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - create-default-namespace-job.yaml
      # Import dashboards to Grafana via API (workaround for init container volume mount issue)
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - import-dashboards-job.yaml
      # Deploy Cassandra metrics exporter (standalone deployment)
      # NOTE: Using cassandra-metrics-exporter-deployment.yaml for metrics collection
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - cassandra-jmx-exporter-config.yaml
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - cassandra-metrics-exporter-deployment.yaml
      # Alternative: Add exporter as sidecar to Cassandra pods (DISABLED - using separate deployment instead)
      # - events: ["postsync"]
      #   showlogs: true
      #   command: kubectl
      #   args:
      #     - apply
      #     - -f
      #     - cassandra-exporter-sidecar-fix.yaml
      # Option 3: Add JMX scraping configuration to Prometheus
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - add-cassandra-jmx-scrape-job.yaml
      # Create ServiceMonitors/PodMonitors for metrics collection
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - cassandra-servicemonitor.yaml
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - temporal-services-servicemonitors.yaml
      # Fix all Temporal service prometheus annotations (workaround for chart limitation)
      # - events: ["postsync"]
      #   showlogs: true
      #   command: kubectl
      #   args:
      #     - apply
      #     - -f
      #     - fix-all-service-annotations-job.yaml
      # Patch Prometheus config to filter to temporal namespace only
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - patch-prometheus-config-job.yaml
      # Fix Cassandra gossip configuration (seed nodes and JVM options)
      - events: ["postsync"]
        showlogs: true
        command: kubectl
        args:
          - apply
          - -f
          - fix-cassandra-gossip-config-job.yaml

  # Temporal HelloWorld Worker Service
  - name: temporal-helloworld-worker
    namespace: temporal-helloworld
    createNamespace: true
    chart: ./temporal-helloworld/charts/temporal-helloworld
    # HF-08: needs temporal frontend gRPC up before worker can poll task queue.
    needs:
      - temporal/temporal
    values:
      - ./temporal-helloworld/worker-values.yaml
    labels:
      component: worker
      app: temporal-helloworld

  # Temporal HelloWorld Go Web Service
  - name: temporal-helloworld-go-web-service
    namespace: temporal-helloworld
    createNamespace: false
    chart: ./temporal-helloworld/charts/temporal-helloworld
    # HF-08: needs temporal frontend gRPC up before web service can submit workflows.
    needs:
      - temporal/temporal
    values:
      - ./temporal-helloworld/go-web-service-values.yaml
    labels:
      component: go-client
      app: temporal-helloworld

  # S3 CRUD API
  - name: s3-crud-api
    namespace: dtaske
    createNamespace: false
    chart: ./s3-crud-api/charts/s3-crud-api
    values:
      - ./s3-crud-api/values.yaml
    labels:
      component: api
      app: s3-crud-api
